svg.title: The rh loop: plan, implement, review, merge, run, analyze
svg.desc: Three swimlanes. Human: four orange gates (publish, merge, budget, conclude) and blocker answers. Agents: the plan, implement, review (fresh session) and run skills, merge.py, and the three-line report. Record: issues, the pull request, the Verdict comment, the squash merge, MLflow runs, and the results comment with its spec check and the study table.
